Mind-controlled slave |TV actor =[[Casey Hendershot]] }} The '''massive legionary''' is a character who appears in the [[Fallout TV series season 2|second season]] of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== The massive legionary is a member of [[Caesar's Legion]] in 2296. He appears to carry an intense hatred for the [[New California Republic]] as an enemy of the Legion, to the point of even disregarding other hostiles. At some point, [[Hank MacLean]]'s mind-controlled [[X-Branch office worker|workers]] would capture him, along with NCR holdout [[Biff (TV series)|Ranger Biff]], and install both with [[Brain-computer interface chip]]s, though the chips were kept inactive, waiting for his orders.{{FOTV|2|6}} The chips on both men were activated by Lucy to prevent the legionary from killing Biff, and the legionary subsequently became another of Hank's friendly and docile office workers. His presence seemingly served a double purpose to convince Lucy that Hank's technology would be the only way to stop the Legion from invading New Vegas.{{FOTV|2|7}} Hank subsequently attempted to use the former legionary as hold down Lucy so that he could install a chip in her as well; this led to the legionary being killed by the Ghoul when he intervened.{{FOTV|2|8}} ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Other Player]]=== The massive legionary was abducted by [[Hank MacLean]]'s mind-controlled slaves and taken to the [[Las Vegas management Vault]], along with [[Biff (TV series)|Ranger Biff]], and both were fitted with [[brain-computer interface chip]]s. When Lucy is about to take her father to the surface to face justice, Biff and the legionary are wheeled out by the [[snake oil salesman]] and another slave, tied to desk chairs. The salesman asks Hank what to do with them since they have not been "fixed" yet, but Hank defers to Lucy to decide whether to activate the chip with the push of a button or let them free. Lucy chooses to let them free, but the legionary, who is the first of the two to be untied, immediately attempts to kill Biff. Lucy steps in to protect Biff from the legionary but is eventually overtaken. Biff attempts to keep the legionary away, only for the legionary to begin hitting him in the head with a stapler. Lucy pleads for Hank to stop them, but Hank answers that the only way to stop them is to hit the button to activate their chips. With Biff being assaulted and no way to stop the legionary, Lucy chooses to hit the button. Biff and the legionary are near-instantly brainwashed, losing all of their previous animosity and their memories of what had happened, with the legionary helping untie Biff and leading him away to receive medical attention. ===[[The Handoff]]=== The legionary is seen mopping the floor outside the door to the room containing the mainframe for the brain-computer interface chips. He stops Lucy and Hank before they enter the room, telling them to mind the floor. This seemingly persuades Lucy to accept Hank's goals on the basis that he can prevent the Legion from ever threatening anyone again. ===[[The Strip]]=== After Hank confronts Lucy for killing [[Diane Welch]], subsequently ruining his ability to program more mind control chips, he reveals that he intends to implant a miniaturized chip in her to pacify her permanently. Hank brings out the massive legionary to hold Lucy down as he installs the chip; Lucy hits the man with her crowbar, but is unable to escape from his grip. Just as she is about to be implanted, the Ghoul throws a knife into the back of the former legionary's neck, killing him and freeing Lucy. ==Appearances== The massive legionary appears only {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|14=206|15=207|16=208}} ==Gallery== Massive legionary mopping.png|Legionary mopping the floor ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Caesar's Legion characters]]
